events.title: 1,000 Wishlists! Thank You, Pirates!
events.summary: Ahoy, pirates!Starforge Pirate has officially passed 1,000 Steam wishlists!I wanted to take a moment to say thank you.This game means a lot to me. There’s a tremendous amount of thinking, tinkering, and testing involved in bringing a project like this to life.
